stories.name_fr: Contribution de Tubi aux revenus publicitaires
stories.explanation: Contribution du service gratuit financé par la publicité (AVOD) Tubi à la croissance des revenus publicitaires du segment Television.
stories.signal: Tubi devient un pilier clé de la stratégie numérique de Fox.
stories.description: Tubi contribue significativement à la croissance publicitaire du segment Television grâce à la croissance continue des audiences numériques.
stories._validation: Type corrected to 'Revenue' (Tubi revenue contribution component); name_en clarified as platform contribution; value corrected to 0.550 B $ (MD&A mentions 'continued digital growth led by Tubi' as part of ~550M increase in advertising revenue outside sports/political impact); unit set to 'B $'; history corrected to [null, 0.550] as this is segment component not total; yoy set to 'N/A' as separate yoy not disclosed; ttm set to null

stories.name_fr: Impact des revenus de programmation sportive
stories.explanation: Revenus générés par la diffusion d'événements sportifs majeurs comme le Super Bowl et impact sur la croissance publicitaire.
stories.signal: Le Super Bowl LIX a généré un pic historique de revenus publicitaires.
stories.description: La diffusion du Super Bowl LIX en février 2025 et la hausse des tarifs NFL ont contribué à 870 millions de dollars de l'augmentation des revenus publicitaires selon le MD&A.
stories._validation: Value confirmed as 0.870 B $ from MD&A ('approximately 870 million impact related to sports programming'); unit corrected to 'B $'; name_en updated to clarify this is impact component; history corrected to [null, 0.870]; yoy set to 'N/A' as comparative sports impact not disclosed; ttm set to null; story_category corrected to 'Market' (standard English term)
